content:
maya: Quick note for managers  appeal window + extension flow finalized. Summary: 3 business day appeal window after feedback release. Extensions only via the extension sheet (link in the playbook).
chris: Where's the rescind form? I had a manager ask about major score changes after submission.
maya: Rescind form is live in the playbook under 'Forms' (short link: https://go.redwood/rescind). Use only for score changes >0.5 or factual errors. Requires manager + cal-lead signoff.
vivian: Can you confirm that rescinds are logged in audit trail? Some managers want transparency.
sam: Yes  audit log will show original snapshot + amendment note. People Ops will append reason and approvers.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Appeal window opens at 1850060000 (feedback release) and closes at 1850319200 (3 business days). Auto-notifications enabled.
chris: If a reviewer submits late and we accept it, does that change the appeal window for that employee?
maya: No  appeal window tied to release time, not individual submit time. Late accepted scores are included in calibration but employees still get the same release time for appeals.
vivian: Minor process Q: who triages appeals? Manager + cal lead first, People Ops only if escalated?
sam: Correct. People Ops handles escalation, fairness checks, and final audit. We'll publish triage SLAs in the FAQ.
chris: Last thing  can we add a required short justification field on rescind requests? Makes review faster.
maya: Done. Added a 1-2 sentence justification field and a required evidence upload (screenshot or doc).
people-ops-bot: Action: Managers update playbook link and check 'rescind' form permissions. Auto reminders will go to managers 48h and 6h before the end of appeal window.
maya: Thanks team. If you expect exceptions, please file via the extension sheet and ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:
